effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 [Arata Sanada] and 1 card with the [Unidentified] or [CS] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon with [Diaboromon] in its text would leave the battle area, by deleting 1 of your other [Diaboromon], it doesn't leave.
